candidate.description: National Cheeseburger Day National Cheeseburger Day If there’s one day on the calendar that feels made for us, it’s the National Cheeseburger Day. Afterall, we’ve been putting our spin on the great American cheeseburger since 2004 with the ShackBurger And what’s a better way to celebrate than with extra beef? From 14 – 18 September, celebrate National CheeseBurger day with a FREE Beef Patty add-on* with any ShackBurger or SmokeShack purchase via the Happy Point app. The Cheeseburger Formula The cheeseburger has earned its place as an American classic with a simple formula: beef, cheese, bun and toppings. But when something is made up of just a few ingredients, every one of them matters. So, what makes a great cheeseburger? Let’s break down the basics. Real Beef For us, a good cheeseburger starts with the beef. That’s why our beef patties are made to order with 100% Angus beef. Each quarter-pound beef patty is smashed to order, seasoned, seared and cheesed to bring together the rich, beefy flavor and juicy texture that fans know and love. Real Classic We believe in keeping good things simple. So when it came to our version of the great American cheeseburger, reinvention wasn’t really on the agenda. Getting it right was. While it sounds simple, getting simple right actually took years of tinkering, tweaking and plenty of tasting before we landed on the ShackBurger, a classic in its own right that continues to let the beef speak for itself. Now that you know the beef, come taste it for yourself! How to redeem: Tap on ‘Order’ Select a ShackBurger / SmokeShack Select Double – the second patty’s automatically on us! (Or go triple with a little top-up if you’re going all in) Check out and enjoy! *Terms and conditions: Promotion is valid from 14 to 18 September 2026, while stocks last. Promotion is available exclusively through the Happy Point Singapore app and is not valid on third-party delivery platforms. Promotion is valid for ShackBurger and SmokeShack only, with a second beef patty included at no additional charge. Top-up charges apply to any additional beef patties beyond two, as well as selected modifiers. Valid at all Shake Shack Singapore outlets. Shake Shack Singapore reserves the right to amend or terminate the promotion without prior notice.
